verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair axis for a database product, but the evidence only shows building blocks. Vector, BM25 and graph retrieval let developers build AI apps, and an MCP endpoint lets external agents run queries. None of this documents HelixDB itself generating insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
